name: Clinical monitoring: subgroup and per-site metrics, safety events as records
description: Each decision names its coarse monitoring groups (site, age band, sex), vetted against an allowed list, so metrics can be sliced by group and site; each safety event is a signed record in the decision ledger.
limits: Slices are only as good as the groups each deployment chooses; small groups give noisy rates (metrics below min_n are not compared). A safety event record is not a regulatory report: national incident reporting still applies.

frameworks.title: DCB0160 clinical risk management (deployment and use)

controls.title: Metrics sliced by group and site
controls.requirement: Each decision names its site and subgroups from the allowed list, so failure, override and outcome rates can be compared across them.

controls.title: Safety events are records
controls.requirement: Each safety event is recorded with what happened, when, the harm, who reported it and the decisions concerned, as a signed record in the ledger.
